_about: Feeds the weekly job reads. kind: pm = written for working PMs; ai = AI in practice; general = tech/business context. At most 2 of the 8 Signal items may come from non-pm kinds. Vetted Oct 2026 against live feeds (latest 8 posts free vs paid-only are in the notes). Reforge and First Round Review were dropped: 0 of 80 picks in issues #32-#41.
